summary: Adecoagro S.A., a Luxembourg-domiciled South American agribusiness listed on the NYSE (AGRO), filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 earnings release and unaudited condensed interim IFRS financial statements for the period ended September 30, 2026. The release cites 9M26 pro forma adjusted EBITDA of $471.8 million, an all-time high for a nine-month period, with growth in Fertilizers and Food & Agriculture offsetting weaker Sugar, Ethanol & Energy results. Prior Profertil and Caarap mill acquisitions are referenced as completed, not new. No special-situations event is disclosed; watch leverage and interest burden.
